p: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners
a: spake in time past unto the fathers
s: by the prophets,
d: revealed his glory unto the ancient elders
showed forth his salvation unto the patriarchs
declared his holy covenant unto the people

p: Who being
a: the brightness of his glory
s: , and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
d: the fountain of his mercy
the mystery of his grace
the beginning of his kingdom

p: Therefore we ought to
a: give the more earnest heed
s: to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
d: hold fast the faithful word
abide in the holy commandments
stand firm in true righteousness

p: How shall we escape,
a: if we neglect so great salvation
s: ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
d: if we despise the heavenly calling
if we turn from the holy covenant
if we refuse the word of grace

p: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God,
a: let us hold fast our profession
d: let us draw near with boldness
let us keep the holy faith
let us rejoice in hope of glory

p: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth
a: to make intercession for them
d: to give everlasting life unto all
to establish them in his kingdom
to cleanse their hearts from evil

p: And let us consider one another
a: to provoke unto love and to good works
d: to establish peace and brotherly kindness
to walk in holiness and true righteousness
to keep the commandments of the Lord

p: Not forsaking
a: the assembling of ourselves together
s: , as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
d: the holy communion of the saints
the fellowship of the righteous
the gathering of the faithful

p: By him therefore let us offer
a: the sacrifice of praise to God continually
s: , that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
d: the prayer of faith before the Lord always
the offering of righteous deeds with joy
the pure worship of our holy Father

p: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices
a: God is well pleased
d: the Lord is delighted
our King is glorified
the Father is praised

p: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear,
a: slow to speak, slow to wrath
d: patient in spirit, meek in mind
gentle to all, harmless in heart
sober in life, peaceful in speech

p: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and
a: receive with meekness the engrafted word
s: , which is able to save your souls.
d: hear with gladness the message of truth
keep with diligence the holy commandments
follow with patience the heavenly counsel

p: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself
a: unspotted from the world
d: blameless before all men
faultless in every way
cleansed from every sin

p: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so
a: faith without works is dead
s: also.
d: hope without patience is vain
knowledge without love is nothing
righteousness without truth faileth

p: And
a: the fruit of righteousness
s: is sown in peace of them that make peace.
d: the blessing of eternal peace
the wisdom of heavenly grace
the reward of faithful obedience

a: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord
s: , and he shall lift you up.
d: Bow down before the majesty of God
Seek ye the face of the Most High
Walk meekly in the paths of wisdom

p: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye
a: holy in all manner of conversation
d: blameless in every work of faith
righteous in all the ways of truth
steadfast in the hope of glory

p: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye
a: love one another with a pure heart fervently
d: walk together in brotherly peace continually
abide in the truth with all meekness of spirit
serve the Lord Jesus Christ with great joy

p: As newborn babes,
a: desire the sincere milk of the word
s: , that ye may grow thereby:
d: seek after the true bread of heaven
receive the faithful promises of Christ
drink of the living waters of life

p: Finally,
a: be ye all of one mind
s: , having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
d: walk ye in the holy truth
stand ye fast in the faith
abide ye in perfect peace

p: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for
a: charity shall cover the multitude of sins
d: righteousness shall deliver the soul from death
grace shall establish your hearts in all truth
mercy shall triumph over righteous judgment

p: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while,
a: make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you
d: guide your footsteps into everlasting life
keep you blameless in holiness and peace
preserve your souls until the heavenly kingdom

a: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you
s: through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
d: Mercy and truth be granted unto you
Hope and comfort be with your spirits
Righteousness and joy abide in you

p: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that
a: pertain unto life and godliness
s: , through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
d: lead unto righteousness and peace
belong unto the heavenly calling
bring forth everlasting salvation

p: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall
a: neither be barren nor unfruitful
s: in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
d: never stumble nor turn aside
not be shaken nor dismayed
always walk in living light

p: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to
a: make your calling and election sure
s: : for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
d: keep the commandments of the Lord
stand steadfast in the holy truth
abide faithful unto the great end

p: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace,
a: without spot, and blameless
d: in holiness and true peace
established in righteous faith
cleansed from every evil work

p: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God
a: abideth for ever
d: shall never perish
hath eternal peace
reigneth in life

p: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear,
a: we shall be like him
s: ; for we shall see him as he is.
d: we shall behold his face
we shall reign with him
we shall enter into rest

p: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and
a: love one another
s: , as he gave us commandment.
d: walk in the light
keep his sayings
abide in his peace

p: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love
a: dwelleth in God, and God in him
d: abideth in the light of eternal life
walketh in the holy truth of heaven
hath the fellowship of the Holy Spirit

a: He that hath the Son hath life
s: ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
d: He that believeth the word shall endure
Whosoever loveth the Lord hath peace
He that followeth the light hath joy

p: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that
a: ye have eternal life
s: , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
d: ye are born of God
your sins are forgiven
ye know the true God

p: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and
a: shall be with us for ever
d: abideth in our hearts always
guideth our feet into peace
comforteth our souls continually

p: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning,
a: that we love one another
d: that ye walk in truth
that ye keep his law
that we abide in peace

p: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that
a: Jesus Christ is come in the flesh
s: . This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
d: the Lord Jesus is the holy Son of God
the eternal Word was made known unto men
the Saviour hath redeemed us from our sins

p: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius,
a: whom I love in the truth
d: whom I greet in the Lord
who abideth in holy peace
who walketh in all charity

p: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee,
a: even as thou walkest in the truth
d: because thou art faithful in all things
seeing thou lovest the brethren with pure heart
forasmuch as thou keepest the holy word

p: Demetrius hath
a: good report of all men
s: , and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
d: great honor among the saints
praise from all the brethren
good testimony in the church

p: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and
a: preserved in Jesus Christ
s: , and called:
d: sealed with the Holy Spirit
called unto eternal life
established in the faith

p: Mercy unto you, and
a: peace, and love, be multiplied
d: mercy, and truth, be with you
grace, and hope, abound in you
joy, and light, fill your hearts

p: How that they told you there should be
a: mockers in the last time
s: , who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
d: false teachers in the world
ungodly men full of deceit
deceivers walking in darkness

p: And others save with fear,
a: pulling them out of the fire
s: ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
d: turning them from every evil way
leading them into righteous truth
delivering them from utter ruin

p: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear
a: the words of this prophecy
s: , and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
d: the voice of the Lord
the counsel of the Spirit
the gospel of the kingdom

p: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and
a: every eye shall see him
s: , and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
d: all the nations shall fear
the heavens shall depart
the saints shall rejoice

p: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not;
a: I am the first and the last
d: I am the root of David
I am the light of the world
I am the prince of life

p: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying,
a: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
s: , which was, and is, and is to come.
d: Great, great, great, King of eternity
Worthy, worthy, worthy, Lord of all hosts
Righteous, righteous, righteous, God Most High

p: Saying, Amen:
a: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving
s: , and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
d: Salvation, and majesty, and peace, and righteousness
Praise, and adoration, and dominion, and truth
Kingdom, and eternal grace, and mercy, and love

p: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit,
a: that they may rest from their labours
s: ; and their works do follow them.
d: for they shall enter into eternal glory
because their reward is with the Most High
and they shall receive the crown of life

p: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty;
a: just and true are thy ways
s: , thou King of saints.
d: holy and righteous are thy judgments
great and mighty are thy wonders
glorious and fearful are thy deeds

p: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying,
a: Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth
d: Hosanna: for the day of righteous salvation is come
Amen: for the eternal Lamb of God hath conquered
Glory: for the sovereign Creator of heaven is exalted

p: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold,
a: the tabernacle of God is with men
s: , and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
d: the kingdom of our Lord is established
the dwelling of the Holy One is revealed
the glorious city cometh down in peace

p: And he said unto me, It is done.
a: I am Alpha and Omega
s: , the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
d: I am the true Light
I am the Lord of glory
I am the Prince of peace
